requiredBehavior: Given an explicit workspace identity, enter the matching continuous environment and return its bounded context/capability capsule; reject mismatched project binding, and expose entry performance and resident status for that same workspace.
summary: The local Forge environment entry cannot produce the bounded MNCS context capsule for mncs-forge because the selected repository has no mncs-forge.toml. The configured Forge MCP project surface is bound to mncs-reference-studies, so its status is not a valid substitute for this requested workspace. Target-specific entry latency, capability context, and idle resident behavior therefore remain unmeasured.
title: Continuous entry cannot bind the requested workspace
